messages:
incidents-bot: :rotating_light: Paging oncall: P1 routing fallback loop detected for customer-facing inference routes. Impact: elevated latency (200-800ms increase) and ~5% 5xx spikes for routes hitting eu-west-1 -> global fallback. Auto-detect triggered at 2026-03-15T09:17:56Z. thread_ts=1799009876

maria (oncall-sre): on it. seeing repeated 'no compatible variant in region' errors followed by fallback to global which then triggers a second fallback back to eu-west due to old policy — looks like a policy loop. attaching logs. :eyes:

aj (eng-runtime): thanks, can you paste the policy JSON that was deployed? suspect the schema migration that removed "preferred_region" defaulted to "any" which our router treats as global fallback now.

maria (oncall-sre): pasted snippet from policy service logs:
```
{"route":"/generate","routing_policy_version":"v3","fallback_priority":"deprecated_field_missing","variants":[{"id":"redwood-7b-quant","region":"eu-west-1"},{"id":"redwood-7b-quant-cheapest","region":"global"}]}
```

maria (oncall-sre): note: fallback_priority used to be explicit (region-first), new schema omits it and defaults to "global-first" in the runtime, causing requests to bounce between regional and global pools.

samir (prodops): customer reports seeing higher latency and some truncated responses. CS alerted. leah, can you confirm which tenants are affected?

leah (customer-success): two customers (acme-corp, finix) on dedicated capacity in eu-west-1. acme reported 30% slow responses this morning, escalated at 08:50. they see model mismatch errors (getting a smaller quant variant).

aj (eng-runtime): quick mitigation plan: 1) disable cross-region fallback for impacted routes 2) pin model variant to regional stable 3) roll back the config migration that removed explicit fallback policy. I'll need deploy approval for a hotfix.

maria (oncall-sre): +1 to that. I can flip a runtime flag to disable fallback immediately if we have the flag. searching...

deploy-bot: action required: approve deploy for service routing-policy (hotfix/disable-global-fallback) by @aj to prod. CI: all green.

aj (eng-runtime): approving and kicking the hotfix. ETA ~3m for rollout across edge proxies.

infra-bot: rollout status: 30% -> 60% -> 100%. No errors reported.

maria (oncall-sre): flipped runtime flag: `enable_cross_region_fallback=false` for route /generate on eu-west-1. Observability: immediate drop in cross-region requests. latency back to baseline for most traces. :white_check_mark:

leah (customer-success): acme-corp confirms latency improved to normal levels. They still saw a few 502s during the flip window but acceptable. finix still reporting one truncated output — looks like a variant mismatch.

aj (eng-runtime): pinned variants for the two tenants to `redwood-7b-quant` in eu-west-1 via routing-policy override. Command used:
```
PATCH /v1/policies/overrides/tenants/{tenant_id}
{"route":"/generate","variant_override":"redwood-7b-quant","region":"eu-west-1"}
```
Applied to acme-corp and finix.

maria (oncall-sre): monitoring traces show reduced error budget burn. I'm keeping the page open for 30m for handoff.

samir (prodops): we should revert the schema deployment that removed the explicit fallback field. Is there a migration PR?

aj (eng-runtime): found the PR: "remove_preferred_region_field" merged yesterday. It was intended to simplify policy docs but we missed a runtime default change. I'll open revert PR and include a compatibility shim.

leah (customer-success): coordinating with acme-corp: they'll keep a support channel open. their SRE asked for timeline; can we give an ETA for permanent fix?

aj (eng-runtime): ETA for revert + compatibility shim: ~2 hours to land, run canary, then 30m for full rollout. Communication: we'll follow up in 3 hours with post-mitigation summary.

maria (oncall-sre): handoff to night oncall at 11:00Z. tagging @aj and @samir for follow-up. leaving monitoring dashboards pinned.

deploy-bot: hotfix deployment (disable-global-fallback) completed at 2026-03-15T09:22:34Z.

aj (eng-runtime): revert PR opened: #4821 "compat: preserve explicit fallback behavior when schema omits field". Adding automated test to ensure default is region-first.

samir (prodops): postmortem notes in progress. root cause: schema change removed an explicit default causing runtime to choose a different fallback semantics. contributing factors: no canary on routing-policy schema, lack of guardrail in runtime for deprecated fields, and missing tenant-level integration tests.

leah (customer-success): logging follow-up: sending affected tenant list + sample traces to acme-corp SRE.

maria (oncall-sre): marking incident as mitigated. leaving P1->P2 if we still have follow-up tasks. handoff: night oncall please watch for any reappearance of cross-region traffic and errors.

aj (eng-runtime): will monitor and confirm once revert is rolled. I'll post final status here.

incidents-bot: Incident update logged: mitigation applied, hotfix and overrides deployed, revert PR opened. Incident will remain open until revert rollout completes.

leah (customer-success): acme-corp follow-up: appreciative of rapid response. requested a written incident summary and timeline.

aj (eng-runtime): final update: revert merged and canaryed at 11:05Z, full rollout at 11:40Z. compatibility shim added. Verified default behavior is region-first. closing incident after postmortem doc creation.

maria (oncall-sre): incident closed at 11:50Z. creating incident ticket and linking postmortem. Thanks team. :clap:
